description: This file defines the main UI entry point for a notes management Android application using Jetpack Compose. It sets up a scaffolded layout with a top app bar, bottom navigation bar with tabs for Notes, Tags, and Settings, and displays corresponding screens based on user interaction.

classes.name: BottomTab
classes.description: An enum class representing the bottom navigation tabs, each with a label and icon.

methods.name: NotesApp
methods.description: Composable function that sets up the main app UI with a scaffold containing a top bar, bottom navigation, and content area based on selected tab.
